description_en: Cibhāḥkhyaḥ Caitya is located at Kaṅkeśvarī, Kathmandu. It is constructed on a relatively open space and this city quarter is named Cibhāḥkhyaḥ after thecaitya.It has a three-level plinth, constructed with bricks, and plastered withbajramortar. There is a staircase on the western façade of thecaitya. Statues of four Buddhas are placed in its four cardinal directions. Dissimilar to many othercaityas, the shape of Chibhāḥkhyaḥ Caitya’s dome (garbha) is unique (see the monument photos). Motifs of four Buddhas are kept on thehaliṃpauabove theharmikā.The local community members believe that this is one of the Aśoka Caityas and was constructed by King Aśoka himself. It is believed that the place, where thecaityastands, was a pond of milk (durupukhū), Aśoka filled it, and constructed thecaitya. However, there is no evidence to verify these beliefs.Pruscha(1975, vol. II, p. 38) mentions that a person called Kelayel Tuladhar constructed thiscaitya. However, neither there is evdience to prove this claim, nor the local elders are aware of it. Pruscha might have misspelled the above-mentioned name. Some of the local elders believe that the Śreṣṭhā family who runs the Hotel Ambassador at the Lazimpat Road, Kathmandu, constructed Chibhākhyaḥ Caitya.Thecaityawas renovated in 1983 CE (VS 2040) after a tree, sprouting out of thecaitya’s upper part,trayodaśabhuvana, threatened to topple it. In the present-day, no one worships thiscaitya. Previously, the above-mentioned Śreṣṭhā family members used to worship it on the full moon day of Vaiśākha. A local community member, named Radhākṛṣṇa Śāhī, takes care of thecaityain the present-day.
description_ne: काठमाडौंको कंकेश्वरी क्षेत्रमा यो चैत्य रहेको छ । खुल्ला ठाउँमा चैत्य बनाइएकोले टोलको नाम नै चिभा:ख्य: रहन गएको हो । यो चैत्य तीनतहको अग्लो पेटीमाथि बनाइएको छ । इँटा प्रयोग गरी बनाइएको यस चैत्यको बाहिरी भागमा वज्र प्लाष्टर गरिएको छ । चैत्यमा चढ्न पश्चिमपट्टि सिँढीहरू बनाइएका छन् । चैत्यको चार दिशामा नियमानुसार चार बुद्ध स्थापना गरिएका छन् । चैत्यको गर्भको आकार अन्य चैत्य चैत्यभन्दा अस्वाभाविक देखिन्छ । चैत्यको हर्मिकामाथि राखिएको हलिंपौमा चार दिशामा चार बुद्धको प्रतीक स्वरूप चिन्हहरू राखिएका छन् । तर पश्चिम दिशामा राखिएको हलिंपौमा अमिताभको प्रतीक स्वरूप पद्म राखिनुपर्नेमा चक्र राखिएको छ । चैत्यमा इँटाकै त्रयोदशभुवन बनाइएर यंसिँ राखिएको छ ।स्थानीयहरू यस चैत्यलाई अशोक चैत्य भन्छन् र सम्राट अशोकले नै निर्माण गरेको विश्वास गर्छन् । अशोकले यस ठाउँमा चैत्य बनाउनुभन्दा अघि यहाँ दुरुपुखू (दूधको पोखरी) थियो र अशोकले दुरुपुखूलाई छोपेर यो चैत्य बनाएको भन्ने विश्वास रहेको छ । तर यस सम्बन्धी कुनै प्रमाण पाइएको छैन । अहिलेको चैत्यको स्वरूप निकै नयाँ हो ।Pruscha(P-100) ले यो चैत्य केलयेल तुलाधर (Kelayel Tuladhar) ले निर्माण गरेका हुन् भने लेखेका छन् । सम्भवत: यो अशुद्ध नाम हो र स्थानीयहरू पनि यस नामबाट अनभिज्ञ छन् । स्थानीयका अनुसार ठमेलमा Hotel Ambassador चलाएर बसेका श्रेष्ठहरूको पुर्खाले यो चैत्य निर्माण गरेका थिए । चैत्यको त्रयोदशभुवनबाट पीपलको रूख उम्रिएर चैत्य नै भत्केने अवस्था आएपछि चन्दा उठाएर विसं २०४० (सन् १९८३) मा चैत्यको जीर्णोद्धार गरिएको थियो ।अहिले यस चैत्यमा कुनै पूजा हुँदैन । प्रत्येक वर्ष वैशाख शुक्ल पूर्णिमाको दिनमा Hotel Ambassador का श्रेष्ठ परिवारका सदस्यहरू आएर चैत्यको पूजा गर्थे । अहिले चाहिँ उनीहरूले पूजा बन्द गरिसकेका छन् । अहिले स्थानीय राधाकृष्ण शाहीले चैत्यको रेखदेख गरिरहेका छन् ।

historical_events.event_description: Ratnadāsa, Śyāmadāsa, and other family members established this Dharmadhātujinālaya Caitya (KAT1000-013) in the memory of their family members.
Rāma Bahādura Khaḍgī, together with his family members, constructed this Dharmadhātujinālaya Caitya (KAT1000-007).

historical_events.event_name: Establishment of a Statue of Rāma-Lakṣmaṇa-Sīta
historical_events.event_description: Kānchā, Moti, and their family members established this statue.

historical_events.event_name: Establishment of a Statue of Vagalāmukhī
historical_events.event_description: Ratnakeśarī Śāhī and her family members jointly established this Vagalāmukhī statue in the memory of Kṛṣṇa Prasāda Śāhī.

historical_events.event_name: Establishment of a Statue of Viṣṇu (KAT1000-015)
historical_events.event_description: Mānadāsa, Jñānī, and other family members established this Viṣṇu statue.

The Caitya was renovated in 1983 CE (VS 2040) after a tree sprouting out of thecaitya’s upper part,trayodaśabhuvana, threatened to topple it. During the renovation, various archaeological finds were unearthed in thecaitya's dome,garbha, which are kept at the back inside the dome, including some gold coins and other items.

historical_events.event_name: Establishment of a Metal Statue of Akṣobhya (KAT1000-014)
historical_events.event_description: On the occasion of the ninetieth birthday of Bila Bahādura Śāhī, son of Dhanasīṃ, his family members installed this statue.
Cibhāḥkhyaḥ Caitya was repaired, renovated, and painted with the support of the Ward Office.
